probe_detail.name: Presence of a standard boilerplate 'About' footer block
Density of numerals and digit strings in the text
Supplies information not already public or self-evident
Quantified, concrete announcement of what actually changed

final.name: Operational commitment at scale
final.audit_justification: Whether an initiative is backed by real resources, staffing, or enforcement versus being merely aspirational is direct evidence of substantive newsworthiness.

final.name: Direct incident facts vs. reassurance-letter voice
final.audit_justification: Whether hard incident facts are surfaced plainly and early versus buried under reassurance language speaks to the substantive disclosure content a journalist would extract, not merely to style.

final.name: Capture integrity: extraction residue and mid-sentence truncation
final.audit_justification: This scores extraction/scraping damage to the document, a pure artifact of how the text was captured, with no plausible link to the substance of the release.
final.upstream_parent: the corpus scraping and extraction pipeline interacting with the structure of the source page (a corpus-construction artefact, not a property of the release)

final.name: Presupposes an earlier installment in series
final.audit_justification: Whether the text presupposes an unrecapped earlier installment is a self-containedness/context-dependency property of the writing, not the substance itself, though being part of an ongoing serial story could plausibly also signal higher underlying stakes.
final.upstream_parent: position in the run of releases this organization has issued on this specific topic (a follow-up vs. an opening announcement)

final.name: First disclosure here, not restatement of already-public facts
final.audit_justification: Whether the central fact is genuinely entering the record here versus rehashing already-announced material directly measures novelty, a core substantive component of newsworthiness.

final.name: Reactive rebuttal framing that names an external antagonist
final.audit_justification: Scores the structural extent of point-by-point rebuttal against a named outside party rather than whether the response is right or wise, but being the subject of a real controversy serious enough to warrant rebuttal could also signal genuinely higher-stakes underlying content.
final.upstream_parent: a reactive trigger on the production side - an outside event, filing or press story forced this item to be written at speed, rather than it arriving from a planned announcement calendar

final.name: Calendar and embargo markers
final.audit_justification: Detects rote calendar/embargo/newswire-cycle phrasing such as quarter-end references or 'for immediate release', procedural furniture unlikely to track genuine substance.

final.name: Recurring data-bulletin format
final.audit_justification: Flags a routine, template statistical-bulletin format; by nature this marks habitual, expected content, which if anything predicts lower rather than genuinely better substantive newsworthiness.
final.upstream_parent: recurring distribution or editorial desk practice

final.name: Consumer Marketing Call-to-Action
final.audit_justification: Measures how much the text reads like retail advertising copy, with an explicit instruction not to judge the marketing's quality, a genre/format marker rather than news substance.

final.name: Cross-industry or ecosystem-wide implications
final.audit_justification: Directly measures the scale of real-world consequence across companies, industries, or regulatory regimes, a core substantive impact criterion for newsworthiness.

final.name: Independent celebrity, humor, or stunt hook
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the release's actual content contains a hook (celebrity, humor, stunt) that would independently draw journalistic interest, a recognized substantive news value.

final.name: Formal wire-service dateline and ticker format
final.audit_justification: Scores formal newswire dateline/ticker conventions with an explicit instruction not to treat the formatting as evidence the news is more important, though paying for formal wire distribution plausibly correlates with more established organizations whose disclosures are also genuinely more consequential.
final.upstream_parent: the distribution tier/channel the release was issued through (a major paid financial newswire vs. an organization's own owned blog/newsroom page)

final.name: Concrete actionability for consumers or users
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the release gives the audience something concrete and immediately actionable, a substantive utility criterion bearing on genuine newsworthiness.

final.name: Cultural crossover or named celebrity figure
final.audit_justification: Measures whether a recognizable celebrity or cultural institution genuinely extends the story's real-world reach beyond the routine corporate beat, a substantive prominence criterion.

final.name: Breadth of public or consumer impact
final.audit_justification: Directly measures the size of the population genuinely affected by the change, a core substantive impact/magnitude criterion.

final.name: Quantitative Data & Index Dump
final.audit_justification: Scores density of numerical data with minimal narrative context, an explicit density measure ('do not judge accuracy or importance'), more a data-dump genre marker than substantive evidence.

final.name: Character-encoding corruption (mojibake) density
final.audit_justification: Scores visible character-encoding corruption, a pure technical artifact of the capture pipeline, with the text itself instructing it must not be treated as evidence of the item's care or importance.
final.upstream_parent: the character encoding of the source page and the decoding step of the harvesting pipeline - which in practice tags which organisation's CMS the item was pulled from

final.name: Distinctive quotable voice rather than interchangeable corporate template
final.audit_justification: Scores the writing's register or authorial voice independent of whether it contains facts at all, a style marker, though an organization confident enough to write in a distinctive voice may also be the kind that discloses genuinely more substantive news.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction explicitly severs itself from content -- 'judge only manner of expression; a release with no facts at all can still score 10' -- and its 0-anchor is a literal enumeration of boilerplate (dateline, ticker, benefit-laden subheads, 'About [Company]' block), so a judge scoring it is measuring inverted boilerplate and house register, which the protocol names as Track B, not the newsworthiness of what is being announced. Mixed is true because a comms function confident and skilled enough to write in an unmistakable voice plausibly also has genuinely more substantive news to disclose, so the same upstream cause can produce real quality.

final.name: Formal filing or legally consequential step by the issuer
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the item carries real legal force such as filings or binding enforcement, a direct substantive-consequence criterion explicitly distinguished from the readability of the legal language.

final.name: Serious dramatic incident with significant stakes
final.audit_justification: Measures whether a specific, consequential dramatic incident involving danger, jeopardy, harm, or crime is actually recounted, a substantive stakes criterion.

final.name: Forwarded or republished internal communication markers
final.audit_justification: Scores framing language marking the item as a forwarded/republished internal communication, a production-provenance marker, though an unpolished internal memo made public could also carry more candid substantive disclosure than a normal press release.
final.upstream_parent: distribution practice of republishing internal communications as external content

final.name: Distinctive human-interest access
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the release offers genuinely distinctive access to a person, place, or experience with concrete particulars, a substantive human-interest criterion.

final.name: Strong time-sensitive news peg
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the item is anchored to genuine time-sensitive stakes such as a crisis, deadline, or live event versus timeless content, a substantive timeliness criterion.

final.name: Operational specificity
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the release states concretely what will change, for whom, and how, versus vague intentions, direct substantive specificity.

final.name: Self-contained announcement quality
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the text is a coherent, complete announcement with an identifiable subject and supporting details versus a fragment or listicle, substantive completeness of the news item itself.
